description: This file defines a wizard for transferring unsold auction lots between auction dates in an OpenERP/Odoo module. It includes form definitions, data retrieval, and update logic for auction lots, bid lines, and history records.

classes.name: transfer_object
classes.description: Wizard interface class for transferring unsold auction lots between dates.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Initializes the form with the current auction date of the selected lot.

methods.name: _transfer_unsold_object
methods.description: Performs the transfer of unsold lots to a new auction date, deletes bid lines, and logs history.
